second_upstream._note: The commit flannel v0.28.10's images/Dockerfile checks out; built as its Makefile `build` target does (CGO_ENABLED=0, -s -w -extldflags=-static -buildid=, -trimpath). It has no module dependencies.

binaries_from_source.name: flanneld
binaries_from_source._note: Makefile dist/flanneld: CGO_ENABLED=1 on amd64 (pkg/backend/udp's C proxy needs cgo), -ldflags '-s -w -X github.com/flannel-io/flannel/pkg/version.Version=$(TAG) -extldflags "-static"' with TAG from git describe (v0.28.10). Upstream links musl statically on Alpine; here glibc is linked dynamically (the binary runs only in this image, on the glibc it was built against; a static glibc binary would dlopen NSS modules at run time). `flanneld --version` prints v0.28.10 to stderr.

binaries_from_source.name: install-conf
binaries_from_source._note: images/Dockerfile: CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o dist/install-conf ./cmd/install_conf/ (no ldflags). The install-cni init container runs `/opt/bin/install-conf /etc/kube-flannel/cni-conf.json /etc/cni/net.d/10-flannel.conflist`.

binaries_from_source.name: iptables-wrapper
binaries_from_source._note: From source.second_upstream; `iptables-wrapper install` runs at build time.
